answer_1.quote: We further perform the experiments fine-tuning the text-to-image diffusion models for the subject-driven generation task.

answer_2.quote: After visual instruction tuning, we evaluate the trained model on 9 popular benchmarks, including MMBench EN/CN , SEED Bench , AI2D , SciQA , TextVQA , MathVista testmini , MM-Vet , and MME . All the evaluations are done using the VLMEvalKit (Contributors, 2023a).
